subject: Request: Marketplace listing exception + onboarding sprint plan
messages:
From: Alexandra Price <aprice@bluepeak.com>
To: Diego Fernandez <diego_fernandez@redwood.com>
Date: 2026-09-12T09:15:00-07:00
Subject: Request: one-time listing eligibility exception + onboarding support

Hi Diego,

Thanks for the quick intro last week. BluePeak is preparing to list a new managed integration for real-time inference on both AWS Marketplace and GCP Marketplace. During our internal review we learned GCP is reclassifying the SKU and the standard listing fee / eligibility thresholds will block our low-touch offering for the first 6 months.

To avoid losing momentum with a pilot customer (expected production Q4), we’re requesting a one-time marketplace listing eligibility exception on GCP (same ask for AWS in parallel but starting with GCP). Specifically: 
- A temporary "low-touch" listing status that waives the standard listing fee for up to 6 months or until $50k ARR is reached, and
- A short technical onboarding sprint with Redwood engineers to validate tokenization, KV cache sizing, and network egress behavior for the integration.

I’ve attached a zip with listing evidence and a short product brief. We’d like to propose a 3-week onboarding sprint starting week of 2026-09-27 and will sign a narrow SOW (scope: integration test harness + deployment runbook).

Things we can provide now: usage projections, the product brief in the ZIP, and a proposed SOW draft if helpful. Can you advise the right Redwood contacts for a waiver/exception and who owns the GCP onboarding sprint?

Appreciate any flexibility — this pilot is time-sensitive and the pilot customer is a strong reference for Redwood as well.

Best,
Alexandra Price
Head of Cloud Partnerships, BluePeak Systems
aprice@bluepeak.com
+1 415 555 0122

Attachments: bluepeak_listing_evidence.zip (product brief, usage forecast)

From: Diego Fernandez <diego_fernandez@redwood.com>

Cc: Vanessa Ortiz <vanessa_ortiz@redwood.com>, Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.com>

Subject: Re: Request: one-time listing eligibility exception + onboarding support

Alexandra — thanks for the clear ask and for sending the evidence pack. We’re interested in supporting the pilot and I think a narrow SOW + short sprint is the right path. A few next steps from my side: 

1) I’ll loop in Partner Programs (cc’d: Vanessa) to evaluate the eligibility exception and program impact.
2) Marissa (cc’d) will own the SOW and onboarding timeline with your engineering contact.
3) I need a finance check on a temporary fee deferral vs. a credit (Ben will need to weigh in — I’ll route internally).

Can you send the proposed SOW template you mentioned (even a lightweight one) and the customer’s expected GA/production date? We should also confirm if the pilot requires private deployment (VPC) or can run in hosted mode; that affects the sprint scope.

I’ve proposed a kickoff window (week of 2026-09-27) — let me know availability for a 30-min discovery call next week.

I’ll follow up internally and get back with a proposed mutual action plan and a short risk summary for the exception.

— Diego
Diego Fernandez

Folks — forwarding BluePeak’s request. Summary / ask: they want a temporary waiver of GCP marketplace listing fee for up to 6 months (or until $50k ARR achieved) and a 3-week technical onboarding sprint (Redwood engineers to validate integration). Pilot customer is time-sensitive; proposed kickoff week 2026-09-27.

Why I’m flagging:
- Partner motion: strong case for co-sell reference in Q4 if we can move quickly.
- Finance: deferral vs. credit has P&L and cashflow implications (Ben).
- Programs: need to confirm we can grant a one-time exception without changing program-wide rules (Vanessa).

Recommended next messages:
1) Finance pre-approval (Ben) for a conditional deferral cap (I suggest $40k not-to-exceed).
2) Marissa to draft an SOW with a capped not-to-exceed for the sprint and a minimal set of deliverables (test harness, runbook, 2 knowledge-transfer sessions).
3) Legal to review a limited indemnity clause / standard partner addendum (I’ll open a legal ticket after finance & prog OK).

I attached a starter SOW (draft_sow_redwood_bluepeak_v1.pdf) and a GCP onboarding checklist. If you’re comfortable with suggested language below, I’ll send a conditional yes to Alexandra and ask for a quick discovery call.

Suggested external language (short):
"We can provision a one-time marketplace eligibility exception subject to a signed SOW and finance-approved deferred fee cap. Proposed onboarding: 3-week sprint to validate the integration. Redwood will provide engineering hours as defined in the SOW; deferred listing fee will be credited until the earlier of 6 months or $50k ARR."

Please reply with approvals/questions.

Attachments: draft_sow_redwood_bluepeak_v1.pdf, gcp-technical-onboarding-checklist.xlsx

Diego — I support a conditional deferral but with controls. Approve up to $40k of deferred listing fees as a credit against future marketplace settlement, expiring 12 months from sign. Conditions:
- Signed SOW with clear deliverables and acceptance criteria.
- Revenue credit applied only after we confirm pilot account billing (no third-party pass-through).
- Monthly usage reporting for the pilot for governance.

Finance will require a short revenue recognition note; I’ll coordinate with accounting on the mechanics. Legal should still sign off on the addendum but there’s no objection from finance so long as the above conditions are in place.

Ben
